Yes. I found several Toronto boutique/smaller agencies that appear to handle both sides of the job: making the ad creative and actually building/managing Facebook + Instagram (Meta) campaigns.

My shortlist
Agency	Creative production	FB/IG campaign management	Why I'd consider them
ZimaPeak Marketing Inc.	✅	✅	Small Toronto shop; particularly geared toward local/small businesses. Strong fit if you want one team doing creative + lead-gen ads.
PPC Guru	✅ Static/carousel + short video	✅	Performance-focused and relatively boutique. Explicitly combines Meta ads, creative production and lead/CRM work.
Creative Squad Inc	✅	✅	Toronto-based and more creative-oriented; offers social marketing and Facebook/Instagram advertising.
Qode Social Media Agency	✅ Photo/video/social creative	✅	Particularly interesting if you want content creation + paid social rather than just someone operating Ads Manager.
Neighbourhood Creative	✅ Photography, video, design, creative direction	✅ Paid advertising	Boutique creative agency with a broader brand/content capability. Good if the ads need substantial original production.
ORCAFY Marketing Agency	✅ In-house video/static/carousel/UGC	✅	More performance-marketing oriented. Their site specifically says they handle creative production, Meta setup, testing and ongoing optimization. 
Orcafy

Creative Scope	✅	✅	Boutique/small-to-mid-market positioning, combining brand/visual creative with paid advertising.
Arnold Street Agency	✅	✅	Creative + digital agency with a production studio; client feedback specifically mentions them handling Google, Facebook and Instagram ads.
Two especially worth investigating

1. ZimaPeak — probably closest to the "small agency does everything" model. Their Toronto operation focuses on smaller/local businesses, and their offering combines Meta advertising with creative designed to stop the scroll.

2. Qode Social — worth a look if creative quality is as important as media buying. Their offering combines social content, photography/video, paid social, targeting and A/B testing.

There's also MAD Social Agency, which is unusually explicit about the package: custom creative shot for each campaign, Facebook/Instagram management, tracking, testing and optimization. Their Toronto Meta management starts at $2,000/month, according to their site. 
MAD Agency

For comparison, MetaBaz advertises in-house video, carousel and static creative plus complete Meta campaign setup, starting at $599/month management (ad spend separate), although they're based in Richmond Hill rather than Toronto proper. 
MetaBaz

If you tell me your approximate monthly ad spend (e.g. $2k, $5k, $10k+) and what you're advertising, I can narrow this to 3–5 genuinely small Toronto shops, including their approximate fees, minimum budgets, creative capabilities, and examples/case studies.
